onboardingEngineRegistry.description: OnboardingEngineRegistry provides SSR-safe instance management for multiple OnboardingEngine instances. Unlike static module-level registries, this class-based approach prevents cross-instance pollution in multi-tenant/SSR environments and allows explicit lifecycle management.

options.name: steps
options.description: The list of steps in the onboarding flow. Each step should implement the OnboardingStep interface

options.description: Unique identifier for this onboarding flow. Useful when running multiple flows on the same page

options.description: Human-readable name for this onboarding flow

options.name: flowMetadata
options.description: Optional metadata for the flow (e.g., target audience, feature flags)

options.name: initialStepId
options.description: The initial step ID to start the onboarding flow. If not provided, the first step in the steps array will be used

options.name: initialContext
options.description: The initial context for the onboarding flow. This can be used to pre-populate the context with data

options.description: Optional plugins to extend the functionality of the onboarding engine. Each plugin should implement the OnboardingPlugin interface

options.name: analytics
options.description: Analytics configuration for tracking onboarding events

options.name: cloudOptions

options.name: userId
options.description: The user ID for tracking user-specific events

options.name: registry
options.description: Optional registry instance for SSR-safe engine management. If provided, the engine will register itself with this registry instead of the global one. Recommended for SSR environments to prevent cross-request state pollution
